book_title: The Able Queen: Memoirs of a Hump Pilot Lost in the Himalayas
author: Rainy Horvath
book_description: The Large Print version of the experiences of World War II Transport Pilot, the late Robert Binzer, as a combat transport pilot with the 14th Airforce flying the China-Burma-India Hump from 1943 to 1945. His plainspoken tale of flying weapons, ammunition, medical supplies, and troops behind enemy lines and over "The Hump" in unimaginable weather conditions inspires readers of every age.A rare first-person narrative of historical accuracy, The Able Queen is perfect for anyone interested in exploring a forgotten corner of World War II from a time when Americans and Chinese fought side-by-side against the Axis of the East. Not historical fiction or romance, this tale reminds readers of the cost of freedom and the bravery of the Greatest Generation.Show more
